subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Attended and unattended implement-now runs retain executor events at .pyxis/logs/executor/events.jsonl and tee operator diagnostics into a private per-run file. Watcher events use .pyxis/logs/watch, and phasemeter run records use .pyxis/logs/phasemeter. Explicit execution-log write destinations must remain inside the shared local-log boundary; readers can still consume explicitly supplied existing exports.
intent: Make execution history available for local diagnosis across both execution modes without turning transient run records into shared project state.
rationale: Attended execution needs the same retained diagnostics as unattended execution. Replacing scattered defaults with producer subdirectories gives users one ignored location, while write-path validation prevents an override from accidentally creating tracked logs.
fit_criterion: Executor tests verify journal creation and unwritable destination errors. Phasemeter tests verify the new default and reject an outside-tree write destination before transcript access. Watch tests use the relocated store.

provenance.note: Records executor, watcher, and pipeline measurement diagnostic storage.
